# netactuate_dedicated_os_profiles (Data Source)

Reads Dedicated Os Profiles visible to the account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netactuate_dedicated_os_profiles" "example" {
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `os_profiles` (List of Object) List of dedicated OS profiles. The API field named id is exposed as os_id because Terraform reserves id for resource state. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--os_profiles))

<a id="nestedatt--os_profiles"></a>
### Nested Schema for `os_profiles`

Read-Only:

- `default_disklayout` (Number)
- `default_scripts` (List of Number)
- `disklayouts` (List of Object) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedobjatt--os_profiles--disklayouts))
- `enabled` (Number)
- `flavor` (String)
- `group_name` (String)
- `last_updated` (String)
- `location_id` (Number)
- `name` (String)
- `os_id` (Number)
- `profile_id` (Number)
- `public` (Number)
- `rescue_image` (Number)
- `scripts` (List of Object) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedobjatt--os_profiles--scripts))
- `set_root_password` (Number)
- `tags` (List of String)
